title: Player Death Sound
description: Play a sound on player death or kill.
body:
This mod adds a configurable sound and some other effects upon **player death or kill**.


<details>
<summary>All Features</summary>

- Custom player death and kill sound
- Spawn lightning bolt on player death or kill
- Death screen customization
  - More death screen backgrounds
  - Change title color
  - Change title contents
  - Toggle title, death message and score visibility
- Flash custom image to the screen on death
- Auto respawn

</details>
